title: Civil maintenance of GI Aerial mast tower at Azhikode DGPS station
summary: Offline sealed quotation (percentage rate) for repainting and greasing two 30 m GI trestle aerial mast towers at Azhikode DGPS station, Thrissur, Kerala.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Gandhinagar, Kadavanthra P.O., Cochin

sites.name: Azhikode DGPS station (Azhikode DGNSS & Lighthouse, Azhikode, Thrissur, Kerala)
sites.work: Civil maintenance (priming, enamel painting, greasing) of 2 Nos 30 m GI trestle aerial mast towers

scope.item: Priming coat with ready mixed red oxide zinc chromate primer on galvanised iron/steel works of 30 m high trestle tower (2 nos.) after scraping and cleaning, incl. bosun chair/jhulla/scaffolding; rate Rs 114.59, amount Rs 41,252.40
Synthetic enamel painting of previously painted surface of G.I trestle tower (30 m high) - 2 nos., two or more coats at all heights; rate Rs 161.55, amount Rs 1,16,154.45
Greasing the tower foundation bolts and nuts after cleaning and covering with tarpaulin; rate Rs 2,415.00, amount Rs 4,830.00
Finishing with acrylic smooth exterior emulsion paint (two or more coats @ 1.67 ltr/10 sqm) on existing cement paint surface; rate Rs 151.22, amount Rs 1,360.98

money.performance_security: 5% of quoted amount by DD/FDR from any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; released after completion
money.notes: Estimate is the schedule total of Rs 1,63,598.00 with rates including cost index 24.3%. Contractors quote a percentage below/above; rate inclusive of GST and all charges. No EMD mentioned. No escalation permitted.

period.completion: 01 month from date of issue of work order

eligibility: No eligibility criteria printed; contractor to submit PAN card copy and bank account details for payment
L1 decided on lowest amount quoted
specs: Two GI trestle towers, 30 m high
Red oxide zinc chromate primer; synthetic enamel paint in two or more coats; acrylic smooth exterior emulsion @ 1.67 ltr/10 sqm
notes: Scanned bilingual NIQ with Annexure-I schedule of work and Annexure-II terms (34 clauses). Blank forms issued 13.03.2026 to 24.03.2026 (10:00-16:00); site inspection allowed in same period; submission by 25.03.2026 15:00 to Cochin directorate or station in charge, Azhikode. Opening date not printed (clause 8 only says opening moves to next working day at 16:00 if holiday). Hindi text of clause 31 duplicates clause 30 while the English differs.
